+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.padding import Padding
+from rich.measure import Measurement
+
+def test_padding_measure():
+    console = Console(width=10)
+    # left=10, right=10 => extra_width=20
+    padding = Padding("Hello", (0, 10, 0, 10))
+    
+    measure = padding.__rich_measure__(console, console.options)
+    print(f"__rich_measure__: {measure}")
+    assert measure == Measurement(20, 20)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_padding_measure()

         max_width = options.max_width
         extra_width = self.left + self.right
         if max_width - extra_width < 1:
-            return Measurement(max_width, max_width)
+            return Measurement(extra_width, extra_width)
         measure_min, measure_max = Measurement.get(console, options, self.renderable)
         measurement = Measurement(measure_min + extra_width, measure_max + extra_width)
         measurement = measurement.with_maximum(max_width)
